# Unified 10% low-dimensional comparison

Both methods use a 360³ grid over their input point-cloud bounding box padded by 10% of each coordinate span on each side. RMSE and Chamfer use independent reference-mesh samples and the released training normalization; ghost spacing uses the complete input cloud.
